illuminate.config.title: Illuminate
illuminate.config.enabled.tooltip: Control your lights from Minecraft. When off, your lights go back to their own software.
illuminate.config.saturation.tooltip: How colorful your lights are. Above 100% makes colors stronger on LEDs.
illuminate.config.smoothing.tooltip: How slowly the lights change between biomes, caves and times of day. Flashes are not affected.
illuminate.config.frame_rate.tooltip: How often the lights update. Lower it if your devices lag behind.
illuminate.config.reduce_flashing.toolti: Makes damage, lightning and explosion flashes softer and slower. Turning on the game's Hide Lightning Flashes setting also softens lightning.
illuminate.config.dim_in_menus.tooltip: Dims your lights while the pause menu, your inventory or another screen is open in a world.
illuminate.config.idle_mode.tooltip: What your lights do in the main menu, the world list and the server list.
illuminate.config.idle_mode.panorama.too: Shows the colors of the main menu panorama.
illuminate.config.idle_mode.off.tooltip: Your RGB software takes over until you join a world.
illuminate.config.idle_color.tooltip: The color shown when Main Menu is set to Color.
illuminate.config.show_preview.tooltip: Shows your lights in the top left corner of the screen.
illuminate.config.show_virtual_room.tool: Shows a small desk setup lit by Illuminate in the top right corner. Useful for showing the mod without your own lights. Stays visible when you hide the HUD with F1.
illuminate.config.log_events.tooltip: Writes damage, explosions, lightning and other events to the game log.
illuminate.config.environment.tooltip: Lights the room based on the biome, the time of day, the sun and the moon. Caves take the color of nearby light. The Nether and the End have their own colors.
illuminate.config.portals.tooltip: A purple swirl while you stand in a Nether portal.
illuminate.config.weather.tooltip: Rain, snow, Nether embers and End particles in the room.
illuminate.config.submerged.tooltip: Colors the room while your head is in water, lava or powder snow.
illuminate.config.status_effects.tooltip: Tints the room in the colors of your status effects. Night vision, blindness, darkness and nausea also change the lights.
illuminate.config.boss_bars.tooltip: Tints the top of the room in the color of the boss bar.
illuminate.config.low_health.tooltip: A red heartbeat when your health is low. It gets faster as your health drops.
illuminate.config.hazards.tooltip: Lights up when you burn, freeze or run out of air.
illuminate.config.sleep.tooltip: Dims the lights as you fall asleep.
illuminate.config.damage.tooltip: Flashes when you take damage. The color depends on what hurt you and the flash is stronger on the side the hit came from.
illuminate.config.world_events.tooltip: Flashes for nearby lightning and explosions, totems of undying and level ups.
illuminate.config.fireworks.tooltip: Shows nearby fireworks in their colors, on the side and at the height they explode.
illuminate.config.event_intensity.toolti: How strong damage flashes and world events are.
illuminate.config.preview.tooltip: Shows your lights. Play an effect to test it.
illuminate.preview.off: Illuminate is not controlling your lights
illuminate.config.signalrgb.tooltip: Sends the lighting to the Illuminate effect in SignalRGB. Place your devices on the SignalRGB canvas where they are around your screen.
illuminate.config.overlap: SignalRGB and OpenRGB are both on. A device controlled by both will flicker. Turn it off in SignalRGB or set it to Off under Device Positions.
illuminate.config.signalrgb_apply_effect: Switches SignalRGB to the Illuminate effect when Minecraft starts sending lighting.
illuminate.config.signalrgb_effect.toolt: Copies the Illuminate effect to %s. Restart SignalRGB afterwards.
illuminate.config.signalrgb_port.tooltip: Port of the SignalRGB canvas API. Only change it if SignalRGB uses a different one.
illuminate.config.openrgb.tooltip: Controls your devices through the OpenRGB SDK server. Start the server in the SDK Server tab of OpenRGB. Set devices that SignalRGB controls to Off under Device Positions.
illuminate.config.openrgb_host.tooltip: Address of the OpenRGB SDK server. Use 127.0.0.1 when it runs on this computer.
illuminate.config.openrgb_port.tooltip: Port of the OpenRGB SDK server.
illuminate.config.placement.tooltip: Where this device is in your room. This decides which part of the lighting it shows.
illuminate.config.placement.left.tooltip: For a device to the left of your screen.
illuminate.config.placement.center.toolt: For a device behind or in front of your screen.
illuminate.config.placement.right.toolti: For a device to the right of your screen.
illuminate.config.placement.above.toolti: For a device above your screen, like a light bar.
illuminate.config.placement.below.toolti: For a device below your screen, like a keyboard or an LED strip under the desk.
illuminate.config.placement.surround.too: For a device that goes around you, like an LED strip around the room.
One color mixed from all of the lighting. Good for devices with a single light.
illuminate.config.placement.off.tooltip: Illuminate does not control this device.
illuminate.toast.effect_installed: Effect installed. Restart SignalRGB to use it.
